messages:
marie: quick poll — should internal S2S APIs be gRPC+proto-first, or keep JSON/REST for easier gateway/front-end compatibility?
aj: +1 for proto-first for S2S. typed contracts catch a lot of bugs. but ops cost for gateways goes up. :thinking:
sam: i worry about browser clients and third-party integrators. gateway still needed either way. can we standardize gRPC internally and expose JSON at edge via a lightweight translator?
kevin: that 'translator' is where we lose telemetry fidelity and quota attribution. translators often drop headers. we need a contract for header propagation and a minimal semantic mapping.
natalie: agreed. console UX needs per-route telemetry that ties back to the original proto method. if a gateway renames endpoints we should still show method-level latency and cost.
marie: proposal sketch: 1) proto-first for all internal routes, 2) a standardized gateway adapter that does header passthrough+content-negotiation, 3) enforce a compatibility policy for proto changes via CI.
aj: +1, and add an envoy filter snippet we can reuse. e.g.:
```yaml
- name: envoy.filters.http.router
  typed_config: {}
# header-preserve: x-rw-forwarded-for, x-client-id, x-request-id
```
sam: love the CI policy. we should also wire canary rollouts in console so product teams can flip gRPC->JSON edge mapping when we detect regressions. UI needs an obvious rollback button and sampling toggle.
kevin: quotas: if internal is proto, should per-route quota keys be proto method names? that'd make console reporting clearer. downside: existing clients using path-based quotas would break. need a migration plan.
natalie: console visualization idea: a heatmap that shows quota pressure per-method and a timeline of mapping changes from gateway. that would help ops diagnose sudden spikes after a rollout.
marie: compatibility policy draft for CI (very short): 1) additive-only proto changes allowed on trunk; 2) remove/rename requires canary + 7-day grace where gateway responds to both names; 3) CI publishes a breaking-change diff artifact for console.
aj: how does this work with streaming RPCs? browsers may not support streaming easily. gateway should provide long-poll or SSE fallback and annotate telemetry with original RPC semantics.
sam: +1. and document grpc->json mapping for error semantics: map grpc codes to HTTP status with consistent JSON error shape so SRE and product can set alerting thresholds.
kevin: example error mapping we used elsewhere: `{ "code": "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED", "msg": "quota exceeded", "quota_scope": "team:ingest" }` — console can index `quota_scope` for quick grouping.
natalie: console needs to display sampled raw proto headers for debugging (privacy scrubbed). minimal sampled payloads help debug mapping mismatches.
marie: ops concern: sampling rate defaults? I'd propose 0.1% global, 5% for canaries, and per-route overrides in console.
aj: that's reasonable. we should also add an API for SDKs to opt-in to richer tracing for dev builds.
sam: one more UX ask: when a route is behind the gateway, show an explicit badge in the route list ("edge-mapped") and a link to the gateway mapping config so teams understand semantic translation.
kevin: +1. and include a small CLI helper to validate mapping prior to deploy: `rwctl gateway validate-mapping --file m.yaml`
marie: ok i'll draft an RFC combining: proto-first S2S, standardized gateway adapter, CI compatibility policy, telemetry/quotas schema, and console UX items (heatmap, canary controls, sampled headers). will ping docs/sre for input.
deploy-bot: marie requested review from @aj, @sam, @kevin, @natalie — deploy checklist created: rfc/transport-ergonomics DRAFT -> reviewers added.
aj: thanks. small nit — include guidance for third-party API surfaces (we likely keep REST API for public but share proto as canonical doc).
marie: noted. i'll include a section: 'public surface mappings' with recommended cadence for proto->openapi sync.
sam: awesome. if you want i can mock console heatmap UI next week. :thumbsup:
